dialogArray: Hey what kind of room are you in?
im in an office with a large wooden desk, theres a standing globe and wooden floor.
is there a rug on the ground?
yes there is a rug under the desk and desk chairs.
where in the room are you standing.
in the corner of the room near the door and far from the windows.
Where are you?
I'm in a bedroom with a wooden floor and a greyish bed that has stripes. there is a dresser against the wall opposite the foot of the bed.
Great, I found the room, where are you standing?
I'm between the foot of the bed and the dresser.
Hi. Where are you?
There is a massage table with beige blanket over it. There is a white sink next to a wood counter/cabinet and a white shower behind me.
I think I see the room. What else is in there?
There is also a tall brown cabinet on the wall opposite of the sink and counter and a white robe hanging on a hook outside of the shower.
I see it now. Where are you in the room?
I am in the doorway between the shower and massage room.
Describe the room you are in.
Garage standing behind the black car, wish I had that car.
You are behind it in the small space?
I am about 4 feet back from the trunk on the driver side tail light.
Hi, what can you tell me about the area you are in?

I am in a dining area by a wooden table with 8 chairs. This is next to a living room I am standing at the end of the table and If I look to my right there is the living room. NO walls between the 2 rooms.
Ok great I am very warm. What else about where you are exactly standing that will help me?
the table is sitting on a white rug, covering a wooden floor.
Are you at the end of the table closest to window?
Yes, exactly where I am.
Describe the room please.
i am i bedroom, yellow and white pattern bedcover. there is a white stool on the bedside.
Where are you standing?
am at the bedroom door.
Describe the room you are in.
I'm standing in one large room with a kitchen and a few living areas. I am standing to the left if you would be walking in the doors from outside at the top of some stairs.
What kind of flooring?
There is a small section of wood flooring at the top of the stairs. All around that is cream tile. I am on the wood floor.
Is there a very long dining table?
Yes, in the kitchen that is near me.
What kind of room are you in?
I'm right at the bottom of the stairs next to a long wooden ding table.
Ok i got you at the bottom of the stairs.
Right, thanks.
What kind of room are you in?

Okay I'm standing on a small desk/office space with two rooms next to me. The flooring of this room is white/cream, theres a small greyish rectangle rug in the middle. A cream sofa chair (single person) that's diagonal against the back corner, white pillow on it. And a desk to on the opposite side.
I think I see you. Is there a grey something on both ends of the desk and possibly a tv or something?
Might not be the right spot, there's black books on one end and ablack lamp on the other side? Theres a small red table against the wall the tan/cream chair is on it has a small black object on it.
Where are you compared to the chair in the corner?
I'm on the grey rug in the middle.
Hello. Where are you?
I'm stuck in some type of wooden area.
Okay You see the thing out in the middle? Its a tall thing dark square on top of it. There is a circle in the floor. Do you see that?
Yes. I see that. I am standing right if front of the tall square thing in the middle.
Inside of the circle area?
yes, i am.
Hello. Where are you?
I'm in a spa. There is a odd shaped pool. Next to it is 3 white chairs. Then a coffee table with 2 green chairs. And a black check in desk.
You are in the spa? Is the spa square? I see the pool. Just trying to figure out the spa.
Yes. I am standing directly in front of the pool.
Hi, what can you see around you?
I am standing on a long red carpet. 2 gold chairs. Small round table.
Anything else to help me find you exactly?
2 black vases on the left side of me.
Hi, all the rooms look a like. What can you tell me about where you are?
Do you possibly see a spot where one of the red carpets leads into nothing?
Like a room with some weird square designs on the floor?

Uhh let's see so from what I can see I have a corner next to me where the red carpet runs and makes an L but then for just barely a few feet this spot I'm on juts out and spots very short. Kinda at a / angle.
What kind of room are you in?
Bedroom with a white bed. At least second floor. Small chair in the corner.
Is the chair in the corner white? If so, where are you in relation to it?
It is white. I am at the foot of the bed. Close to that chair.
Hi, what can you see around you?
Odd shaped rug, oval table, 4 chairs and a couch on the side of it.
I am very close what else about where you are standing exactly?
I'm between the oval table and rectangle coffee table.
Hi, can you see anything around you?
I am in the gym. Next to a treadmill.
What are you standing next to?
By the wood floor, and treadmill.
hello, where are you?
im in a bedroom. wood floor with a rug in front of the bed. it has a chair in front of the bed as well. bed is dark colored.
is the chair crooked in the corner?
yes it is. im in the door way.
Hi there! What's the area around you look like?
I am in a room with a blue spread with an orange color at the top there is a rug beside the bed and two night stands on each side of the bed by the headboard.
Alrighty got ya, where are you standing?
I am standing on that rug.
Hi, can you tell me about the area you are in?
I am standing in a round room. There is brick floor, but in the middle is a white round pattern. Can you see that?
Ok anything else to add?
Very middle of the entry way at bottom of steps.
Hello, what type of room are you in?
im at the bottom of the stairs. i see two chairs next to it.
What does the floor look like?
its brown wood.
Is there a white rug in the nearest room?
yes im at the bottom of the stairs.
Hi, what can you see around you?
I am in a hallway with a hutch at the end of it full of figurines. I am by a doorway and there is an old ironing board to my left that has old irons on it.
Ok anything else you can add?
looking straight ahead through the doorway is a metal clothing rack, and behind me through a doorway is a laundry room.
Hi. What do you see?
Ok kitchen area is long brown table with many chairs aorund it, rectangle. White tile floors, brown wood cabinets all around.
Can you stand behind the middle of table near the stairs?
I am middle of table between kitchen cabinet and table, cant go on other side of table by stairs, sorry but thanks.
Hi. What do you see?
Bedroom, yellow bed two yellow pillows and brown teddy bear on bed. Very small soom only tiny table next to bed.
Can you stand at the foot of the bed?
I am at the foot of the bed close to the entry door, thanks.
Hi. What do you see?
four chairs all facing a small ottomon in the middle.
Where are you standing?
by the ottomon.
Hello. Where are you?
Very top of stairs top floor right outside room with white bed and yellow blanket on it.
You are standing at the top of the steps? I have the spot. Just where exactly are you?
I'm standing in the hallway area right at the top of the stairs, grey carpet as well.
Where are you?
I am standing in the garage . Right inside by the grey garage door. There is a black car in front of me on the right. Directly to my right are what looks like grey lockers or cabinet.
Is the door by the lockers?
Yes , the door you would drive though to the garage. Not a regular doorway.
Hi. Where are you?
In a dining area with a long wooden table on a light rug. It has 10 chairs.
I see it. Where in the room are you?
Put me between the table and the back of the couch.
Okay. The couch is kind of cream color?
Yes, it is.
What type of room are you in?
I am in the dining room. Next to the head of the table.
Which side of the table.
There is a hallway with orange tile. I am on that side.
Next to the head or at the head? Move to the head of the table.
I am now in the hallway. It wouldn't let me move to the head of the table. The hallway has orange tile.
where are you?
I am in  a mostly pink room that has red path all around the floor of a center wall that displays art. There are chairs around the outside also.
where in the room are you?
On one end of the long display wall, there is a small  area that has a pink bench on a rug. I am in front of that.
What do you see?
I am near the kitchen between the kitchen and living room.
I see the kitchen. Where are you standing?
I am near what looks like a bbq range.
Hey, where are you?
small room with a piller in the middle of it wooden benches around it.
Can you see the big white circle in the middle? If so, stand in it. It's surrounded by small black circles.
im at it.
Hi what do you see around you?
I am standing on the end corner of a white and blue pattern tile floor. There is a pool table in this room. I am all the way at the end of the room near a coffee table by the sofa.
Red pool table?
Yes. All the way to the right is the sofa , the table in front of it. I am on the other side of the table between it and the wall with the tv.
Hey, where are you?
I am between the end of the red pool table and the round table with a chess board on it.
Okay, I'll put you there.
Right in the middle of it on the mosaic blue floor tile.
Hi, what can you see near you?
I am in the bedroom with a brown spread with a yellow blanket on the top.
Is there a leather chair in the corner with a brown pillow on it?
yes  there is  I am at the foot of the bed.
tell me about your locationl.
I am in a bedroom with two chairs near the foot of the bed.
where are you standing exactly?
I am right in between the two chairs.
Describe the room you are in, please! 2-story home.
I'm in a kitchen with a square tan colored island, wood cabinets, tan tile floor. there's another island/counter partly separating the kitchen from a living room.
Does the island have 3 tan chairs on one side? Stand on the side opposite those chairs.
The counter that separates the rooms does--the chairs are on the living room side. I'm opposite them now.
Can you tell me about where you are?
In a bedroom. Wood floor with a small shag white rug. Twin size bed. white bed spread.
Is the white rug angled to the corner of the bed?
Yes. I am standing right on the rug.
what can you see?
I see a red pool table.
where are you in the room?
I am at the end of the pool table that does not have the triangle on it.
Hello, what type of room are you in?
In a weird room. There is a bathtub and a floral chair next to it. red rugs and a blue runner rug.
Where are you in relation to the tub?
Standing right in the doorway.
Hello there!  What kind of room are you located in and what furniture is nearby?
I am in a room with 2 white love seats. I am on the red rug in the middle.
Alright!  I think I see it.  Where exactly are you standing in that room?
Smack dab on the middle of the red rug, in front of both love seats.
where can i find you?
white bed with carpet at foot of it with two chairs and a stool on it.
how is the floor?
brown wood. Two of the pillows on bed sort of remind me of a zebra. There is some purple on them too.
where you at?
im next to the fireplace. im in the living room.
with a tile floor?
yes but the floor looks bron in front of the fireplace.
what room?
am at the foot of a stair, going up, there ia bench, brown, the stairs are wooden brown with black rails.
first floor?
yes, the stairs are going up.
Hello!  This is a large house!  What sort of room are you in and what furniture do you see?

I'm in a bedroom. There is a tan and salmon colored bedspread with a salmon colored quilt across the end. There is a cream oriental rug at the end of the bed. There is a chair in the corner. Outside the door is a round hallway.
I think I know where you are.  Are you able to stand near the foot of the bed?
I am exactly in the doorway between the bedroom and the round hallway.
What can you see?
I am in a really small kitchen. Brown counter tops. Do you see that?
Sorry, the big kitchen has white counters, I can't see your kitchen yet.
I am in a dining area that also has a couch in there. Black round table in the corner with four black chairs around it. I am between the table and back of couch.
where can i find you?
I am in a kitchen. the floor is brown wood. There are 2 stone countertops that are rectangle shaped that both have white sinks.
any furniture in the room?
It's a kitchen, so there are some black chairs on the other side. I am exactly between the two counters with sinks.
what can you see?
Formal living room area right off the front entry, sofa chair white rug on floor with table.
where in the room are you?
Edge of the white rug near the front entry by the red chair.
Hi! What is nearby?
I am outside on grass looking back towards the house. I am in the corner.
Can you see a white set of stairs in the grass? It's only about 4 or 5 steps.
Yes I do. I am facing it. It is diagonal to my location up and to the left.
where you at?

Uh oh, just had this place, so the part I'm in has a giant display case in the middle, red carpet that goes around it makes a rectangle leading to other rooms, there's loads of white and red chairs along the walls and a chair with a red cushion near the middle edge.
got the room. where exactly are you standing?
Very middle end of the displaycase, the red cushion chair is to my side, white rope behind me that has two red chairs facing diagonal?
where are you?
I am in a room at the bottom of some stairs. The floor is brick and there is a rug right in the middle.
is the floor tiled?
it is brick but it looks like tiles. Im standing right in the middle of the rug.
Hi, can you tell me what you see?
Im by the stairs.
There are 4 floors here. What else can you see?
Behind me is a mahogony window.
What about the floor?
1st i think.
where are you?
Look to be in a small mini room, red carpet running across the middle to two doorways on opposite ends of the room, there's white ropes blocking some red chairs to my left, and some dressers?
Every room in the house is similar.  Can you see any different flooring in an adjacent room?

Any place that looks like an entrance I can go to? I'm now in a room that has some long display case in the middle of the room, red carpets make a large retangle around it, and there's lots of chairs along the outer wall, one has a red cuhsiona nd the red are a red/white pattern that's fugly.
Ok, I see it. Where exactly are you standing?
Near the back middle of the room, in front of the chair with the red cushion.
what room are you in.
I am standing in a doorway between 2 rooms. one room has 4 redish chairs the other  has a bunch of light colored chairs around the room.
are you in thje middle of the room?
No, in a doorway between 2 rooms.
where are you?
im in a room with a pink floor and a black table.
where in the room?
in the middle.
Hi, what can you see around you? Everything looks almost the same here?
Big pint room, with a large painting of a man.  I am directly in front of the painting.
Can you describe the furniture in the room?
A bunch of chairs and then there is a bench that is roped off next to the painting with a large pink curtain in front of it.
hey! what do you see?
Bedroom, tan floors, very dark brown bedding with a yellow blanket across the bed at the top.
Got it! where are you standing in the room?
Foot of the bed.
What so you see?
I am in a large closet. The floor is dark brown. There is a brown rectangular table in the middle. Room outside I can see cream carpet.
XAn you move to a more descriptive area?
In a bedroom now.  Looks like a corner room. Bed is a light bluish with a chair and ottomon in the corner. White carpet. Foot of bed.
What is around you where you are at?
I'm in the doorway to a bedroom. There is a round painting on the wall behind me there is another room across from me that looks like a library.
Is there a rug on the floor? What color is the bed?
there si a rug. The bed has a white spread and it has four tall corners it looks like.
where are you?

Floor is dark wood, patterned blue and cream rug with a small round coffee table at the center with a fireplace behind it, 2 brown seats with white or light brown arms. There's a cream table on the side.
where in the room are you?
I'm between the seats.
what does your room look like?
i am in a small laundry room, a small white laundry machine.
where are you standing?
near the door.
what can you see?
I am in a bedroom this a bed that has a light colored blanket, there is a chair, brown colored in the corner.
where in the room are you?
Right by the doorway.
where you at?
am in a room with a pool table with a red base.
got you. where are you standing ?
next to the small round brown table.
Hi there! What do you see around you?
I am standing right by the front door. The room has dark brown wood floor and im standing on the cream rug. There are black stairs in front of me.
Think I have ya.
nice one.
Describe the room you are in.
In a bedroom with cream carpet. The bed has white bedsheet with a black comforter over the top. There is a yellow blanket placed in the middle of the bed as well which touches the very first pillow.
Where are you standing?
At the foot of the bed left side near the window.
Where are you?
I am in the outdoors.
What do you see around you?
I see some stairs leading to an outer back door.
I see that. Are you right at the stairs?
near the top of the stair.
What can you see?
I am in a tiny room with sink and toilet.
Are the sink and toilet in the same room ore is there a doorway between them?
same room and toilet is facing sink.
I am not seeing it, can you walk into another room?
room white pillows black bed blanket and there is a light brown blanket at the top of it.
where are you in relation to the bed?
at the foot of it.
I'm here to rescue you! What kind of room are you in?
it has a big wood table in middle.
Can you tell me more about the shape, any chairs, color of the flooring?
pink rug on floor.
Please be more specific, this house has 4 floors and a lot of red flooring. What is the shape of the table and are there any chairs around it?
square table and no chairs.
Where are you?
room with round table and couch next to it. couch is brown and table is behind it.
Is there also two chair sofas?
yes and little bar area.
Where are you in relation to the table?
between couch and table.
What do you see around you?
I'm in the living room, wood floor, 2 rugs, 2 chairs and a small round table on one side, 3 couches on the side with a rectangle table at their center.
Where are you located on that room?
I'm between the 2 chairs with the small round table.
Where are you at?
Bedroom with brown floor. White bed with stripe kind of in the middle. White chair in the corner. At least second floor I think.
Okay where in the room are you?
At the foot of the bed.
Where are you at?
am in a room facing outside, it has a white small table and grey cushioned white coaches.
Okay, where are you in the room?
yes, next to the table.
what room?
Bed with green and tan chair at the foot facing a white fireplace - ottoman in between.
second floor?
Yes, there is a patio outside of it.
Hi, what can you tell me about the area you are in?
I'm in a bedroom. The bed has white covers on it with white pillows and 2 dark pillows. There's a yellow throw on it. I'm near the 2 grey chairs in the room.
I am very close, can you tell me anything else about where you are exactly standing that will help me?
I'm standing near the 2 grey chairs.
where are you?
I'm in a narrow massage room. There's a long narrow bed/table with white cover. There's a white sink at the head of it with brown cabinet.
there are two rooms like that.
There's an open room to my side and a white robe on the wall.
are you near massage tables?
There is only 1 massage table where I am covered with white.
Hi. What do you see?
Hello, I'm in a gym with two treadmills and a weight bench.
Is the floor wood tiles? Can you stand between the mat and treadmills?
Yes and that's where I am. Right in front of both treadmilles.
What type of room are you in?
I think I'm in a top room. Wood floor with light brown patterned rug. There's a white bed with a brown bench with a folded blanket on it. There's a grey chair in the corner with a foot rest.
Found it. Where are you standing?
I'm between the footrest and bench.
What type of room are you in?
I am in front of the kitchen bar. The top is black, and it is large.
I see it. Standing in the center on the living room side?
Yes. Thats where I am.
Hi, where are you?
Top floor loft. Bedroom White bed. Brown trunk at the foot of it.
Where are you standing?
At the foot of the bed.
Describe the room please.
This is a garage. with just one black car.
Where are you standing?
On the side on the car. the only side one can possible stay?
Describe the room you are in.
I'm in a small room. The wood table takes up most of it. There a re 3 brown stools and 2 candle holders holding 3 red candles on each.
Where are you standing?
I'm at the end of the table near the sink.
where are you?
I'm in a room with lots of books. There is a brown desk in the middle with a lot of stuff on it. There is a gold chair near the desk.
any chairs or table?
Just the desk in the middle that has a desk chair and the gold chair. It's not far from the top of the stairs.
Where art thou?
Ha, I'm in a big dining area. 8 red chairs surrounding a wooden table that has a red runner on it. The table is also inside some red square.
Where are you in this room?
I'm standing in the back behind the head table. To me right there is a table with a red table cloth on it and to my left a brown dresser thing.
What kind of room are you in?
am in a room with a rectangular wood brown table with black six chairs around it.
Is it the kitchen?
yes, there is a counter with fruits on it, am standing next to it.
Hi there! What's the area around you look like?
Living room. Bright colored couch with one dark brown chair and the opposite chair lighter. All 3 chair sits on an area rug. with brown wood flooring around them?
Do you see a room near you that has a red pool table?
Yes.. I'm beside the biggest couch. Just between the other dark brown accent chair.
where can i find you?

Good lord this man's closet is bigger than my bedroom.  I moved though, I'm in a bedroom wwith light gray carpeting, a bed with a gold and white patterned quilt, striped pillows, two rectangular night stands, a wood bench by the window, shell-shaped mint chair with orange pillows, and a black TV stand in the other corner.
any chairs?
Just a light minty blue chair that is curved, might look like an oval on  your map.
I'm here to rescue you! What kind of room are you in?
i AM IN THE KITCHEN. A nice white island in the center.
OKAY. Where are you standing?
at the base of the middle of the "round" edge of the island.
Hi. What do you see?
I am in the kitchen between the island and back wall.
Can you also see a table with 3 chairs on both side?
Yes. The island is between me and the dining room.
what room?
Bottom of a staircase. There is a kitchen and dining table to my left and a living room to my right.
anything else?
Nope. I am at the bottom of the stairs. Looking forward, there is a stove in front of me.
Describe the room.
Do you see a circular stairwell. I am at the top of it. White round carpet.
Yes I see that. Where are you standing?
I am on the round carpet.
where are you?
Looks like  living room. Light brown flooring.  3 accent chairs. gray with throw pillows on it. small rectangular white center table. ?
where in the room are you?
I'm between the white table dining and the accent chair?
what room?

I am standing in the doorway to a bathroom. There is light tile flooring. There is a stand up shower to my right. Looking into the room there is a dark cabinet with sink, it looks like a big jacuzzi tub in there too.
anything else?
The shower is to my left actually. The toilet is to my right . In the hallway behind the bathroom is a wood floor with a light colored rug.
What kind of room are you in?
Look for 4 tan chairs around a circle ottoman with a large gold platter on it.
Found it. Where are you standing?
Put me on the ottoman.
What do you see?
upstairs loft area with brown love seats surrounding a square table. there is a beige rug and a small chair and bench in here as well. I see a patchwork rug beyond this room.
Is there a couch too?
yes. I am standing between the small chair and the small bench near the corner tv unit.
What's around you?
im facing down some stairs. i see a bar with chairs behind me.
Do the stairs go up or down?
they go down.
Can you tell me where you are please?
I am in a kitchen. To the left of me is an island with big sink.  On the right is a counter with another sink.  There are colored towels hanging from the center island (red white and blue).
You are b.
I am by the red white and blue towels in between the two islands.
Where you at?
Kitchen, half of it has wooden floors,  the outside of the kitchen has white tile, there are two kitchen islands with grayish marble tops.
I see it. Where are you standing?
I am standing between the two islands, right where the sinks are.
where you at?
Bedroom, tan floor, white bed with a black blanket at the bottom,  there is a black chair in the corner with an orange pillow.
I see you. Where you standing?
On top of the chair with the orange pillow.
Hello!  What kind of room are you standing in and what furniture can you see near your location?
In a gym room. Lots of equipments. The floor is burnt orange color.
I'm pretty sure that I see it.  There are a lot of treadmills?  Anyway, where exactly are you standing?
In front of the very first treadmill.
Hello. the map is large. describe where you are.
Look for a room with red and cream patterned rug and cream couches. There is a fireplace too.
where in the room are you standing?
On the rug between the fireplace and the couch.
What kind of room are you in, and what do you see?
white bed and in front of it are two seats. There is a carpet under them.
Is there something on the floor right in front of the bed?  Like a bench or a chest or something like that?
yes looks red from here. stool in front of chairs. I am in front of stool.
Are you on the side of the stool closer to the chairs, or the other side?
other side.
Hello!  What sort of room are you in and what furniture can you see nearby?
i stand beside a large dinner table. 10 chairs around it. i'm in between it and the pinkish sofa in the next room.
Okay.  I think I know where you are located.
im closer to the dinner table than the sofa.
where can i find you?
I am in the kitchen. There is one island that just has chairs near it. then another one that just has knives on it. That is closest to the stove. the kitchen has wood floors.
what color is the stove?
Stainless steel, but I'm located as if I just walked into the room closest to the island with the chairs.
what room?

I"m in a mini hallway and can see stairs leading down to my right, there is a bedroom to my left that has a bed with orange and white blankets in a weird pattern, and a small square beside table next to it.
I think I got it.
Alright I'm closest to the doorway as I can be to that room.
what kind of room are you in?
It is what appears to be a possible home office. There is a bookcase, a table with a lamp, and a fireplace. THere is a stone statue at the end of the table on the floor.
Colors could be helpful too.
THere is a multicolored rug but it is similar to the rugs in the other rooms. The statue is beige, there is a blue and white vase on the bookcase.
The rug colors are helpful, can you describe them?
pink, blue, green and tan. There is also a very large vertical mirror between the two windows across from the table.
The table is like medium size?
yes and more of a square.
where are you in the room?
to the right of the bookcase if you are facing the portrait that is o n the wall next to the book case, next to the door.
Ok, two more questions, what is the color of the table? how many chairs does it have?
there are zero chairs and the table is stained a honey-ish color.
Not much to go on here, what can you see?
There is a bunch of weird chairs, what looks like "roofs" from the top, but really they are stands.
Can you see circles on the floor in the middle? There is one big one in the middle.
The floor has black and white. The white is a big white circle. It is where I am standing.
I'm here to rescue you! What kind of room are you in?
Hello, I am in a living room/seating area. There is an old faded reddish oriental rug on the floor and two patterned sofas on each wall facing each other.
Are there 3 windows behind one of the couches?
Yes, one windowsill is full of books. There is also a narrow wooden table with a statue on it. I am in front of that table.
For the record, this is my least favorite map because the house is god-awful.
Yeah, this furniture is a mess.
where you at?
I'm in a bedroom with white bedding and a tan leather bench at the foot of the bed. There are two green chairs and a brown leather ottoman on a rug in front of that.
I see it. Where are you standing?
Between the green chairs.
What kind of room are you in?
I am in a room with a fancy patterned rug and two couches that face each other. The fabric on the couches is also complex.
